g1_attestation.tokenizer_load_path: AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(pythia-410m snapshot) — identical to EXP104 G1/bench loading path
g1_attestation.note: artifact fetched from hub at run time; byte-identical to pythia-410m snapshot copy (verified pre-run). Loading config comes from the snapshot's tokenizer_config.json, as in EXP104. Leading-space operationalization carried over from EXP104's G1 probe: the scored token is the next token after the cue, i.e. tok(' ' + option).

d3_blindness: transferred from EXP104 bench_manifest.json: structural-foil designations fixed at bench-build time before any model contact on S4-8 bench items; checker-verified (checker_verification.json + checker_addendum.json in the EXP104 bundle). No re-designation for cloze re-prompting; any post-hoc foil change = disqualification.
